turns.speaker: Interviewer
turns.text: Tell me how you plan a weekend trip.

turns.speaker: Stakeholder
turns.text: I usually compare three hotels before booking, and I want the total price with breakfast visible.

turns.speaker: Stakeholder
turns.text: Yes - I never want a booking confirmed without me seeing the cancellation deadline first.

turns.speaker: Interviewer
turns.text: Would you like the app to remember your filters?

turns.speaker: Stakeholder
turns.text: That would help, though I am not sure yet.

turns.speaker: Stakeholder
turns.text: I want the itinerary to stay readable offline, but only for trips I already booked.

turns.speaker: Stakeholder
turns.text: Overall I want the whole booking process to stay predictable.
